notes: The prompt asks in Turkish for a parkour game of the kind people call an obby tower, which names the genre and the shape outright: Obby & Platformer on course-tower, carrying the genre-wide P6 and the P2 that stacked platforms bring. Took the Tower Obby preset and added obstacle-jump and obstacle-moving so the ten short sections can each be a distinct plain, readable obstacle as the answers ask. The scale answer chooses one uninterrupted climb rather than separate stages, which settles this as a single map with no P4. With no user to ask I assumed a checkpoint at each of the ten stages, since the answers call the sections stages and asked for something immediately playable, and read the summit as the winner-zone payoff; the bright stylized colouring is image theming and produced no options of its own.
